recipe.name: Peru Mary
recipe.description: A spicy, fruity Mary-style mocktail: guava juice seasoned with Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco, fresh coriander and lime.
steps: Press the coriander sprigs gently in the base of a shaker.
Add the guava juice, lime juice, Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco, salt and pepper.
Add ice and roll the drink gently between the shaker and a second tin rather than shaking.
Strain into an ice-filled highball glass.
recipe.ice: Rolled with ice; served over fresh ice
recipe.garnish: A coriander sprig and a lime wedge
